pets.note: The pets' jobs (TODO S2). Level 1 is the pet's bonus from its node (always on, nothing changes). Level 2 opens when the NEXT pet has come home (the last pet has no level 2 yet): then the child chooses one of the pet's jobs on the job board, and the pet does it once every question (the same step as everything else; no questions, no work). A job that cannot run just waits (💤 nothing to do, 📦 the store is full). kinds: weeds and stones (take `amount` from the patch that has most; stones go into the store), water (adds `amount` to the water), makes (an item, `rate` per question, whole units arrive). `first`: what a pet with only its level 1 does for the eye: every `every` questions it walks to `place` ('water', 'field', 'spot:<place>') and shows its emoji.
